import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TERRA = "#C66B4E" SLATE = "#657786" INK = "#263238"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7.2, 3.2), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 14.4) ax.set_ylim(-2.9, 3.5) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.axis("off")
# Schematic geometry only: no measured singular values are asserted. # Both rotations are proper rotations, and the singular values are positive. theta = np.deg2rad(35) phi = np.deg2rad(29) V = np.array([[np.cos(theta), -np.sin(theta)], [np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)]]) U = np.array([[np.cos(phi), -np.sin(phi)], [np.sin(phi), np.cos(phi)]]) Sigma = np.diag([1.36, 0.68]) M = U @ Sigma @ V.T
t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 601) circle = np.vstack((np.cos(t), np.sin(t))) centers = [np.array([x, 1.05]) for x in (1.45, 5.05, 8.65, 12.30)] shapes = [circle, V.T @ circle, Sigma @ V.T @ circle, M @ circle] vector_pairs = [V, np.eye(2), Sigma, U @ Sigma]
for center, shape, vectors in zip(centers, shapes, vector_pairs): ax.plot( center[0] + shape[0], center[1] + shape[1], color=SLATE, lw=1.3, alpha=0.78, zorder=1 ) for j, color in enumerate((BLUE, TERRA)): end = center + vectors[:, j] ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( center, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=11, linewidth=1.9, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=3 )) ax.plot(*center, marker="o", markersize=2.8, color=INK, zorder=4)
# Labels are positioned separately to avoid collisions with arrowheads and curves. c = centers[0] p = c + V[:, 0] ax.text(p[0] + 0.10, p[1] + 0.10, r"$\mathbf{v}_1$", color=BLUE, ha="left", va="bottom") p = c + V[:, 1] ax.text(p[0] - 0.12, p[1] + 0.10, r"$\mathbf{v}_2$", color=TERRA, ha="right", va="bottom")
c = centers[1] ax.text(c[0] + 1.02, c[1] - 0.19, r"$\mathbf{e}_1$", color=BLUE, ha="left", va="top") ax.text(c[0] - 0.16, c[1] + 1.03, r"$\mathbf{e}_2$", color=TERRA, ha="right", va="bottom")
c = centers[2] ax.text(c[0] + 0.80, c[1] + 0.15, r"$\sigma_1\mathbf{e}_1$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="bottom") ax.text(c[0] - 0.17, c[1] + 0.75, r"$\sigma_2\mathbf{e}_2$", color=TERRA, ha="right", va="bottom")
c = centers[3] p = c + (U @ Sigma)[:, 0] ax.text(p[0] - 0.12, p[1] + 0.17, r"$\sigma_1\mathbf{u}_1$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="bottom") p = c + (U @ Sigma)[:, 1] ax.text(p[0] - 0.15, p[1] + 0.14, r"$\sigma_2\mathbf{u}_2$", color=TERRA, ha="right", va="bottom")
# Each local operation acts left-to-right. transitions = [ (2.78, 3.72, r"$\mathbf{V}^{\top}$"), (6.40, 7.02, r"$\mathbf{\Sigma}$"), (10.27, 10.91, r"$\mathbf{U}$"), ] for x0, x1, label in transitions: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (x0, 1.05), (x1, 1.05), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=11, linewidth=1.25, color=INK, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0 )) ax.text((x0 + x1) / 2, 1.43, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=13)
# The complete linear map bypasses the intermediate stages. ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (centers[0][0], -0.22), (centers[3][0], -0.22), connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.25", arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=12, linewidth=1.3, color=INK, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, )) ax.text( (centers[0][0] + centers[3][0]) / 2, -1.98, r"$\mathbf{M}=\mathbf{U}\mathbf{\Sigma}\mathbf{V}^{\top}$", fontsize=14, ha="center", va="top" )
